tools.name: tatango_get_account
tools.description: Show the Tatango account that the API key belongs to (id, login email, username). Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /api/v2/accounts/me.

tools.name: tatango_list_lists
tools.description: List the subscriber lists of the account (name, id, subscriber counts). Use the list id in the other tools. GET /api/v2/lists.

tools.name: tatango_get_list
tools.description: Show one subscriber list by id, including its keywords and opt-in settings. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}.

tools.name: tatango_list_subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribed phone numbers of one list. Opted-out numbers are in tatango_list_unsubscribed. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers.

tools.name: tatango_list_unsubscribed
tools.description: List the phone numbers that unsubscribed from one list. Do not message these numbers. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers/unsubscribed.

tools.name: tatango_get_subscriber
tools.description: Show one subscriber of a list: phone number, name, custom fields and tags. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers/{SUBSCRIBER_ID}.

tools.name: tatango_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom subscriber fields defined for one list. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/custom_fields.

tools.name: tatango_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks that send events for one list (delivery status, replies). GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/webhooks.

tools.name: tatango_list_sent_messages
tools.description: List the messages already sent to one list, optionally within a UTC date range. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/messages.

tools.name: tatango_list_scheduled_messages
tools.description: List the messages scheduled but not yet sent to one list, optionally within a UTC date range. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/messages/scheduled.

tools.name: tatango_get_message
tools.description: Show one sent message of a list: content, send time and delivery counts. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/messages/{MESSAGE_ID}.

tools.name: tatango_add_subscriber
tools.description: Add a phone number to one list, with optional name, email, birthdate (YYYYMMDD) and zip code. Changes the list. POST /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers.

tools.name: tatango_send_transactional_message
tools.description: Send ONE SMS or MMS to one phone number, for example an order or appointment notice. It sends a real text message to a real person. SMS is limited to 160 characters; MMS needs a subject. POST /api/v2/transactional_messages.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tatango_get_account, tatango_list_unsubscribed, tatango_list_sent_messages, tatango_list_scheduled_messages, tatango_get_message, tatango_add_subscriber · Private data: tatango_get_account · Public sink: tatango_get_account, tatango_list_webhooks, tatango_get_message, tatango_add_subscriber, tatango_send_transactional_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tatango_get_account, tatango_list_unsubscribed, tatango_list_sent_messages, tatango_list_scheduled_messages, tatango_get_message, tatango_add_subscriber · Private data: tatango_get_account · Public sink: tatango_get_account, tatango_list_webhooks, tatango_get_message, tatango_add_subscriber, tatango_send_transactional_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
